brief.regime: Indian equity breadth leaned negative with 674 advances against 1,136 declines out of 1,820 stocks scanned, even as smallcaps (+1.58%) and midcaps (+0.57%) outperformed Nifty (+0.06%) while India VIX eased slightly to 17.42 (-0.29%). Outperformance was concentrated in Pharma (+3.42%) and PSU Bank (+3.40%) sectors, whereas IT (-1.54%) dragged the market. Macro conditions were mixed as Brent crude fell to $97.50 (-0.83%) and the rupee strengthened to 93.93 amid $4.1 billion in monthly FII inflows, offsetting pressure from rising US 10-year yields at 4.86% (+0.45%).
